_manifest_note: GlaucoMap ML Version Manifest — FROZEN. Do NOT retrain or modify any model weight unless a critical bug is discovered.

input.description: Quantitative RNFLT map — NOT raw OCT pixels

held_out_test_metrics.dataset_split: held-out test (75 samples, never used in training or validation)

harvard_gd_rnflt_classifier.clinical_status: RESEARCH MODEL — Not clinically validated. Research estimate only. Clinical correlation required.

progression_risk_model.task: Progression-risk estimation from tabular clinical data

preprocessing.missing_handling: median imputer fit on train only; -1 and blank treated as NaN
preprocessing.note: vf_md_proxy is a proxy derived from VF threshold columns (cols 20–80 of Excel), NOT clinical VF MD

held_out_test_metrics_at_threshold_0_30.note: IMPORTANT: Only 7 positive (progressors) in held-out test set

progression_risk_model.clinical_status: RESEARCH ONLY — Not clinically validated. Only 7 positive test cases. Wide confidence intervals. No external validation. No normal controls in the progression dataset. VF MD proxy is NOT equivalent to clinical VF MD. Current model uses baseline information only.

oct_rnflt_segmentation.task: Segment raw OCT B-scan → extract quantitative RNFLT map
oct_rnflt_segmentation.consequence: Raw OCT end-to-end analysis is BLOCKED. Raw OCT uploads MUST NOT produce a structural classification.

raw_oct_end_to_end_pipeline.description: Raw OCT → OCT Quality → OCT→RNFLT Segmentation → Quantitative RNFLT → Harvard-GD CNN → Structural Estimate
raw_oct_end_to_end_pipeline.current_behaviour: OCT imported ✓  |  Image quality checked ✓  |  RNFLT extraction unavailable ⚠  |  Structural AI classification: NOT PERFORMED

independent_module_note: The RNFLT Classifier (Module 1) and the Progression Risk Model (Module 2) are INDEPENDENT. Their outputs MUST NOT be combined. p_glaucoma is produced exclusively by Module 1. Progression probability is produced exclusively by Module 2.

demo_data_safety.rule: Demo RNFLT data MUST NEVER appear after a raw OCT upload. State must be fully cleared on modality switch.
